Tests (complete): in `greet.test.js`, replace line 3 with the import below, keep the existing test, and append the tests after it.

```js
import { greet, shout } from './greet.js';
```

```js
test('greet module exports shout alongside greet', () => {
  assert.equal(typeof shout, 'function');
});

test('shout upper-cases the greeting for Ada', () => {
  assert.equal(shout('Ada'), 'HELLO, ADA');
});

test('shout equals greet upper-cased for sample names', () => {
  for (const name of ['ada', 'McGrath', 'ADA']) assert.equal(shout(name), greet(name).toUpperCase());
});

test('shout with an empty name', () => {
  assert.equal(shout(''), 'HELLO, ');
});

test('shout leaves non-letters unchanged', () => {
  assert.equal(shout('R2-D2'), 'HELLO, R2-D2');
});

test('greet is unchanged after adding shout', () => {
  assert.equal(greet('Ada'), 'Hello, Ada');
});
```
